create_retriever: create a Retriever subclass to implement document retrieval for Wikipedia queries
run_retriever: run the Retriever to retrieve Wikipedia documents matching a set of query ids
set_queries_data: set queries data on the Retriever with a list of dicts containing id and query fields
from_default_config: build a Retriever instance from default configuration using a name string
preprocess_instance: preprocess an instance by passing it through the Retriever's preprocessing hook
